# 单个 Tab 的颜色 / Per-tab Colors

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 以前 Tab 的标题颜色、图标着色只能通过 `tintColor` 或 `tabBar.standardAppearance` 全局设置，所有 Tab 共用一种颜色；选中背景色只能参考 FAQ 中的 Demo 代码自己实现。现在可以在 `tabBarItemsAttributes` 中为每个 Tab 单独设置：未选中 / 选中的标题颜色、未选中 / 选中的图标着色，以及选中背景色。 | Tab title colors and icon tints could only be set for all tabs at once, through `tintColor` or `tabBar.standardAppearance`; a selected background color meant copying the FAQ demo code. Now each tab can have its own, in `tabBarItemsAttributes`: unselected / selected title color, unselected / selected icon tint, and a selected background color. |

## 用法 / Usage

```objc
NSDictionary *live = @{
    CYLTabBarItemTitle : @"Live",
    CYLTabBarItemImage : [[UIImage systemImageNamed:@"dot.radiowaves.left.and.right"] imageWithRenderingMode:UIImageRenderingModeAlwaysTemplate],
    CYLTabBarItemTitleColor : UIColor.systemGrayColor,             // 未选中标题 / unselected title
    CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitleColor : UIColor.systemRedColor,      // 选中标题 / selected title
    CYLTabBarItemIconColor : UIColor.systemGrayColor,              // 未选中图标（模板图）/ unselected icon (template)
    CYLTabBarItemSelectedIconColor : UIColor.systemRedColor,       // 选中图标（模板图）/ selected icon (template)
    CYLTabBarItemSelectedBackgroundColor : [UIColor.systemRedColor colorWithAlphaComponent:0.12], // 经典 / 扁平 / classic, FlatDesign
};

// 运行时修改 / At runtime:
[tabBarController updateTabBarItemAtIndex:1 attributes:@{ CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitleColor : UIColor.systemOrangeColor }];
```

```swift
let live: [String: Any] = [
    CYLTabBarItemTitle: "Live",
    CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitleColor: UIColor.systemRed,
    CYLTabBarItemSelectedBackgroundColor: UIColor.systemRed.withAlphaComponent(0.12),
]
```

### 单个 Tab 的字体 / Per-tab fonts

```objc
NSDictionary *live = @{
    CYLTabBarItemTitle : @"Live",
    CYLTabBarItemTitleFont : [UIFont systemFontOfSize:10],                          // 未选中 / unselected
    CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitleFont : [UIFont systemFontOfSize:11 weight:UIFontWeightBold], // 选中时加粗 / bold while selected
};
```

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 以前只能用 `standardAppearance` 为所有 Tab 设置同一种字体（见 FAQ）。现在可以只改某个 Tab，与颜色、标题偏移写入同一个 item appearance 副本，可同时使用。 | Fonts could only be set for all tabs at once through `standardAppearance` (see the FAQ). One tab can now have its own, written into the same per-item appearance copy as the colors and the title offset, so they work together. |

## API

| Key | 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `CYLTabBarItemTitleColor` | 未选中标题颜色。 | Unselected title color. |
| `CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitleColor` | 选中标题颜色。 | Selected title color. |
| `CYLTabBarItemIconColor` | 未选中图标着色（仅模板图）。 | Unselected icon tint (template images only). |
| `CYLTabBarItemSelectedIconColor` | 选中图标着色（仅模板图）。 | Selected icon tint (template images only). |
| `CYLTabBarItemSelectedBackgroundColor` | 选中 Tab 的背景色（经典 TabBar 与扁平样式）。 | Background of the selected tab (classic tab bar and FlatDesign). |
| `CYLTabBarItemBackgroundColor` | 未选中 Tab 的背景色；未设置选中背景色时，选中后也使用它。 | Background of the tab while not selected; also used when selected if there is no selected background. |
| `CYLTabBarItemTitleFont` | 未选中标题字体（UIFont）。 | Unselected title font (UIFont). |
| `CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitleFont` | 选中标题字体；未设置时使用 `CYLTabBarItemTitleFont`。适用于所有样式（iOS 13+）。 | Selected title font; `CYLTabBarItemTitleFont` when not set. In every style (iOS 13+). |

| 样式 / Style | 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 经典 / 液态玻璃 · Classic / Liquid Glass | 标题与图标颜色写入该 Tab 自己的 `UITabBarItem.standardAppearance`（iOS 15+ 还有 `scrollEdgeAppearance`）：TabBar appearance 的副本，TabBar 的 appearance 改变时自动重建；与 `CYLTabBarItemTitlePositionAdjustment` 共用同一个副本，二者可同时使用。你在 item 上设置的 appearance 会作为基础保留。 | Title and icon colors go into the tab's own `UITabBarItem.standardAppearance` (and `scrollEdgeAppearance` on iOS 15+): a copy of the tab bar's appearance, rebuilt when that one changes, shared with `CYLTabBarItemTitlePositionAdjustment`, so both work together. An appearance you installed on the item is kept as the base. |
| 经典 · Classic | 选中背景色直接填充选中的 Tab 按钮，切换时移动。 | The selected background fills the selected tab button and moves with the selection. |
| 扁平样式 · FlatDesign | 标题颜色写入扁平 item 的标题属性，选中背景色写入其 `selectedBackgroundColor`。 | Title colors go to the flat item's title attributes, the background to its `selectedBackgroundColor`. |

## 限制 / Limits

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 图标着色只对模板图片生效（`UIImageRenderingModeAlwaysTemplate`、SF Symbols）。以图片名传入的图标按原图绘制，不会被着色。 | Icon tints apply to template images only (`UIImageRenderingModeAlwaysTemplate`, SF Symbols). Icons given as image names are drawn as original and are not tinted. |
| 液态玻璃自带选中效果，不支持 `CYLTabBarItemSelectedBackgroundColor`；扁平样式暂不支持图标着色。 | Liquid Glass draws its own selection, so `CYLTabBarItemSelectedBackgroundColor` does not apply there; FlatDesign does not tint icons yet. |
| 标题与图标颜色需要 iOS 13+（`UITabBarAppearance`），iOS 12 上忽略；经典 TabBar 的选中背景色在 iOS 12 上同样有效。 | Title and icon colors need iOS 13+ (`UITabBarAppearance`) and are ignored on iOS 12; the classic selected background works on iOS 12 too. |
